name: Alpenflora
beschreibung: The Alpenflora inn in Ischgl, Tyrol, is situated in a quiet side street about a five-minute walk from the village centre. The rooms are furnished with local wood and feature a balcony. The restaurant offers regional cuisine alongside international dishes. The wellness area includes a sauna and a steam bath. The Silvretta cable car can be reached on foot in just a few minutes. In summer, the inn serves as an ideal base for hikes, and in winter for skiing excursions. Stays are offered with half board.
